name: BlissCarrier - Advisor Outreach (Sep 2026) Prajwal
structure: CHECK(connected: end | new: INVITE(note x1)(accepted: MSG x2 | not: end))

variants.body: Hi {firstNameClean} - Given your operations experience, We'd love to speak with you about being an advisor to our new AI logistics startup. We're confident it'll be bigger than our previous companies - Reachdesk (valued at $225M) & Yieldify (sold to Publicis). Open to a quick chat?

steps.fallback: Hi there - Given your operations experience, I'd love to speak with you about advising the new AI logistics startup I'm building with Jay and Meelan at Blissgrowth. I'm confident it'll be bigger than their prior companies - Reachdesk ($225M) & Yieldify (sold to Publicis). Open to a chat?

steps.what: opener, advisor ask, credibility, asks for a call

variants.body:
Hi {firstNameClean}, great to connect.

Given your background, I imagine you've seen the significant amount of money carriers overcharge and the unclaimed refunds - 10% of all 3PL spend, based on our findings.

That's exactly the problem we're trying to solve with this new logistics startup. Our AI agents audit every invoice, find what they're owed, and recover it automatically.

We'd love to get your perspective and potentially bring you on as an advisor if you're interested.

We're confident it'll be bigger than our previous companies, Reachdesk (valued at $225M) and Yieldify (sold to Publicis).

Open to a quick chat?
